Outsider (Baatezu, Evil, Lawful) · SM +1 Barbed Devil (Hamatula) (Enraged Eggplant; answers SRD 3.5)

A broad rust-black fiend covered head to foot in long spines, with oversized clawed hands and a low wedge of a head. Grappling it is a mistake; so is standing close. It is suspicious of everything, guards what it has been given to guard, and never quite believes the relief is coming.
